description:
List account notifications

Returns the notification inbox of the account behind the API key, newest first by creation time. Notifications are raised by the platform for events such as ticket replies or billing changes, and each entry may point at the resource that caused it through `relatedType` and `relatedId`. Pass `unreadOnly=true` to see only unread entries: the handler compares the raw query string against the literal text `true`, so any other value, including `1` or `TRUE`, is treated as not set. The `pagination` object carries `page`, `perPage` and `total`, the last being a real count of the notifications matching the same `unreadOnly` filter as the page.

page.description: Page to return. Starts at 1; values below 1 are clamped to 1.

perPage.description: Items per page. Clamped to the range 1 to 100; larger values are reduced to 100.

unreadOnly.description: Set to the literal string `true` to return only unread notifications. Any other value is ignored and the full inbox is returned.

name: list_notifications
